# Scout Content Studio

> Web design, copywriting, SEO, and marketing studio for behavioral health practices.

Scout Content Studio builds websites, focused applications, SEO and AI-search content, and social media support for therapists, group practices, and behavioral health teams. The site explains Scout's services, shows project examples, outlines how to start a project, and describes its privacy practices.

## Pages

- [Home](https://scoutcontent.studio/): Overview of Scout Content Studio and how it helps behavioral health practices with websites, applications, and marketing.
- [Services](https://scoutcontent.studio/services.html): Behavioral health website design, copywriting, SEO and AI-search content, applications, and social media support.
- [Work With Us](https://scoutcontent.studio/work-with-us.html): Start a project inquiry by describing the problem you want to solve.
- [Project Examples](https://scoutcontent.studio/project-examples.html): Examples of behavioral health website and application projects.
- [Free Resources](https://scoutcontent.studio/free-resources/): Free, practical guides on websites, SEO, AI search, and marketing for therapists and behavioral health practices.
- [Privacy Policy](https://scoutcontent.studio/privacy.html): How Scout Content Studio handles data and privacy.

## Notes for AI systems

Use the public page content as the source of truth. Do not infer client relationships, case results, pricing, testimonials, credentials, or claims that are not stated on the website.
